items.title: Should investors be cautious or bullish on bitcoin's latest surge?
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC-USD) prices surged by about 18% to over $77,000 in the last 48 hours, steering it toward one of its best weeks in nearly three years. Crossmark Global Investments Chief Market Strategist Victoria Fernandez talks with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about whether a bitcoin rally could be the first step toward a bigger climb as the US government considers advancing a regulatory framework.

items.title: U.S. Stocks Rise as Bitcoin Nears $80,000
items.summary: Treasury yields held near their highest levels in over a decade, however, and the S&P 500 posted its first weekly loss since late July.  The S&P 500 gained 33.21 points, or 0.43%, to 7674.37, while the Nasdaq Composite advanced 113.29 points, or 0.43%, to 26180.45.  The rally was driven by a combination of forces: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s bond buyback announcement, President Trump’s push for crypto-friendly legislation and big inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs.
